configuration.sample_method: Fresh server and client processes per sample; closed-loop client; every response validated; engine order alternates by round.

assessment.interpretation: The original reversed orientation is retained in full as observational history. Valid response completion does not qualify it as a quiet comparison. The source of the recorded whole-host activity is unidentified.

metric_definitions.whole_host_busy_logical_cpus: machineBusyCpuSeconds / machineMeasurementSeconds; a sample-window average from Windows GetSystemTimes kernel + user - idle counters.
metric_definitions.background_busy_logical_cpus: derived.backgroundCpuSeconds / machineMeasurementSeconds; residual whole-host CPU after subtracting measured server and client CPU. It does not identify a process or establish causation.
metric_definitions.cpu_window_limit: Machine snapshots bracket measurement control handshakes. Server and client counters use their measured windows, so the residual is not a precisely aligned process census.
metric_definitions.sample_started_pacific: Raw startedUtc converted to Pacific time. It precedes the time-wait gate and child startup; it is not exact measurement-start wallclock.
metric_definitions.artifact_written_pacific: Raw JSON file modification time converted to Pacific time; completion-write metadata, not exact measurement-end wallclock.
metric_definitions.metrics: Per-sample values, without pooling, row replacement, or causal inference. Server and client CPU utilization are fractions of their assigned CPU budgets.
metric_definitions.affected_sample_boundary_interval_pacifi: Approximate chronology from affected sample start to following recovery sample start. Whole-host values describe separate measurement windows of roughly 10 seconds with intervening gaps; these bounds do not establish continuous CPU activity throughout that interval.

historical_similarity.observed_pattern: Earlier TLS stalled samples also coincided with high whole-host CPU and low measured child CPU. This similarity does not identify a cause or validate a historical gain claim.
